Subject: Novamed reference video — quick plan and scheduling

Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for agreeing to do a customer reference video — really appreciate Novamed making time for this. To keep things simple, here’s a short plan and a couple of scheduling options: 

What we want:
- 90–120 second edited customer highlight for our website & socials
- 2–3 quotes we can pull for case study copy
- B-roll of the product in use (screen capture) if possible

Format options (pick one):
1) Short remote interview (30–40 minutes) — we record via Zoom/Google Meet, you keep the camera you prefer
2) Onsite half-day (2 hours filming + B-roll) — Redwood will bring a small crew (camera + sound)

Proposed dates: Nov 18 morning or Nov 20 afternoon (we can be flexible).

I’ve attached a starter shot list (shot_list_v1.docx) and a draft script outline we use as guidance. We’ll send a formal release (DocuSign) for signature — that’s standard.

If you prefer we can keep things very informal: two short questions and one headline quote, and we’ll handle the editing. Let me know which format and which date works best.

Thanks,
Rafael

Subject: FW: Novamed reference video — script, shot list, and release

Monica/Grace — forwarding Samantha's confirmation. Nov 18 at 10:00 PT is locked in for a remote interview. Please see notes and ask items below.

Quick internal plan: 
- Interview length: 25–30 mins recorded (we aim to edit to a 90–120s hero clip)
- Recording platform: Zoom (we’ll record locally if possible)
- Crew: Producer (Grace) + Editor (contract) — no on-site camera team for remote
- Deliverables: 90s hero, 30s social cut, 3 pull quotes + transcript

Draft interview questions (suggested — keep it conversational):
1) Brief intro: role & how Novamed uses Redwood Inference
2) Biggest business impact they’ve seen (metrics if they can share)
3) One example workflow it replaced or made faster
4) Advice for other teams evaluating inference platforms

Talking points to encourage (we should provide these to Samantha ahead of time):
- Predictable latency & cost controls
- Easy model rollouts and canary testing
- Seamless mix of hosted + private deployment for regulated data

Logistics & asks for production: 
- Send the release via DocuSign before Nov 16 so legal can sign ahead. Link: https://www.docusign.com/templates/novamed-release-2026
- Ask Samantha for any compliance constraints (e.g., pre-approved lines)
- Make sure editor uses Novamed branding from brand guidelines provided

Grace: can you build a lean 1-page script/talking-points doc (3 bullets per question) and a short shot checklist for the producer? Monica: please draft the DocuSign release email that will accompany the contract.

Thanks — Rafael
